sonnet.problem: The joke doesn't match the fact. The Bible point is that the new heavens and earth are new and will last. Papa Dorin says he came out of a closing bakery's bin with a 25 cent sticker, which isn't being brand new and built to last. So 'I KNOW how rare that combo is' leaves a stranger saying 'huh?'.
sonnet.rule: The everyday comparison must have the same action. ... It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining. If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it.

sonnet.problem: The question says He will select some 'of those gathered' as priests and Levites. Isaiah 66:21 says only 'some of them' and doesn't say who 'them' is. The card fixes the referent to the gathered brothers or nations.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
